question: Simple interest on a sum for eight months at the rate of 8 percent per annum is Rs. 240. What is the value of sum?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective interest rate for 8 months = 8 × (8 ÷ 12) = 16/3%

As per the question, (16/3)% of Sum = 240

1% of Sum = (240 × 3) ÷ 16 = 45

100% of Sum = 45 × 100 = 4500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹240

Rate (R) = 8% per annum

Time (T) = 8 months = 8 ÷ 12 = 2/3 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3001218e0d1d066e9605cbecfac6d5c89364ef5509afcf5e52c11bb3bafbcb79.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 240 = [P × 8 × (2 ÷ 3)] ÷ 100

⇒ 240 = (P × 16) ÷ 300

⇒ P = (240 × 300) ÷ 16

⇒ P = 15 × 300

⇒ P = 4500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount Formula

The total amount (A) at the end of the time period is given by: A = P + SI, where P is the Principal and SI is the Simple Interest.

Effective Interest Rate

The overall interest rate accumulated over T years is simply (R × T)%. So, SI = (R × T)% of Principal.

Time Conversion

When time is given in months, divide by 12 to convert it to years (e.g., 8 months = 8 ÷ 12 years). If given in days, divide by 365.

Difference Between SI and CI

In Simple Interest, the principal remains constant. In Compound Interest (CI), interest is calculated on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest.
